name: Reinforced frame
rulesStatus: candidate design; recipe and functional effects provisional
description: Strengthens an assembly's structural implementation without assuming its material, dimensions, or limb count.

name: Articulated construction
rulesStatus: candidate design; recipe and functional effects provisional
description: Jointed or articulated arrangement of suitable components.

name: Flexible construction
rulesStatus: candidate design; recipe and functional effects provisional
description: Permits a compliant or deformable structural arrangement when its component and material allow it.

name: Compartmentalized housing
rulesStatus: candidate design; recipe and functional effects provisional
description: Divides suitable internal housing into accessible sections.

name: Wheeled drive arrangement
rulesStatus: provisional starting-playtest option; recipe and power are candidates; gameplay effects need integration
description: Mounts rotating wheels for suitable ground movement; wheel count, traction, clearance, and walking speed remain governed by actual component and movement rules.

name: Tracked drive arrangement
rulesStatus: provisional starting-playtest option; recipe and power are candidates; gameplay effects need integration
description: Arranges a ground locomotion unit around articulated tracks; traction, terrain restrictions, wear, and load capacities require authored rules.

name: Multi-legged drive arrangement
rulesStatus: provisional starting-playtest option; recipe and power are candidates; gameplay effects need integration
description: Coordinates multiple supported leg assemblies without prescribing a specific number of legs or granting additional actions or speed.

name: Rolling body arrangement
rulesStatus: provisional starting-playtest option; recipe and power are candidates; gameplay effects need integration
description: Uses a rolling enclosure or other rotating body as ground support; articulation and power transmission must come from compatible installed hardware.

name: Compliant manipulator arrangement
rulesStatus: provisional starting-playtest option; recipe and power are candidates; gameplay effects need integration
description: Provides a flexible manipulatory geometry; reach, grip strength, dexterity, and tool access still require suitable capabilities.

name: Layered protective covering
rulesStatus: provisional starting-playtest option; recipe and power are candidates; gameplay effects need integration
description: Arranges multiple protective surfaces in layers with authored locations. Does not itself increase Armor Class, damage reduction, coverage, or resistances.

name: Distributed control arrangement
rulesStatus: provisional starting-playtest option; recipe and power are candidates; gameplay effects need integration
description: Links primary and auxiliary controllers across an assembly; no additional consciousness, simultaneous actions, or immunity to control loss follows.

name: Multiple-operator control arrangement
rulesStatus: provisional starting-playtest option; recipe and power are candidates; gameplay effects need integration
description: Organizes control stations for multiple operators. Separate operators do not gain extra turns or shared action resources by selecting the arrangement.
